{{Version|2.0.4}}
[[File:Stats_Button.png|frameless|left]] '''Stats''' page displays a breakdown of your progress through the different menus in the game, and various information about your ability to gather resources and do damage in a collapsible sidebar on the right. Tapping a stat in the sidebar shows a popup with the name of the stat. Buttons on the bottom allow you to view your Profile - a summary of your account which is especially helpful when seeking advice, roll for a new name, browse the {{Sprite|Miner|Skins|16x16|Skins}} you have unlocked and the bonuses they provide and see your {{Sprite|Relic Sticker|Stickers|16x16|stickers}} and the bonuses they provide. This screen can be exported in JSON format using the <code>{{Sprite|Misc Code|Codes|16x16|EXPORTSTATS}}</code> code and used with [[External_Resources#Spreadsheets_&_Calculators|various  community made tools]].
{{clear|left}}

==Name rerolling==
{{See also|Skins#Name_rerolling}}
In stats menu it is possible to reroll miners name. A free reroll is earned on every prestige, and rerolls can also be purchased for {{Gems|5}} each. Rolling certain name can also grant a permanent [[Skins]]. 

==Skins==
{{See also|Skins}}
Available [[skins]] can be selected via Stats menu. Skins are earned during [[Events]], from opening [[Store#Gifts|Gifts]] and the [[Store#BallerSkinBundle|Baller Value Pack]]. Obtaining miner skins grants extra [[Skins#Skin_Rewards|bonuses]].

==Profile==
Profile menu contains brief information about current game progress. Notably:

Top Left
* [[Founder#VIP_Lounge|Founder tier]], if applicable (profile background is blue for founders)
* Current pickaxe damage
* Total amount of [[Chests#Relic_Chests|Relic chests]] obtained
* [[Store#Gem_Unlocks|Gem unlocks]] 
* Levels of [[Store#Gem_Upgrades|gem upgrades]]
* [[Bombs|Bomb]] cap
* Total amount of [[Skill-Tree|skills]] unlocked
* Current amount of [[Contracts]] completed
* [[Events|Event]] miner and lootbug skins collected

Top Middle
* [[Skins#Name_rerolling|Miner name]] and birth date<ref name="birthdate">The date the player started this save file</ref>
* Current [[Skins|skin]]
* Unlocked [[Construct#Monuments|world monuments]]

Top Right
* Unlocked [[Pets]], their level, their quest rank, and their card tier

* Game [[Stats/Completion|completion]] percentage and full completion point total

Bottom Left
* Total gameplay and offline time
* [[Obelisk]] level
* Generator level
* Unlocked [[Drones]], their grade, and their card tier
* Number of [[Challenges]] completed
* Number of obtained [[Cards]]
* [[Stargazing]] completion points, and [[Stargazing#Black_Hole|Black Hole]] level
* [[Archaeology]] completion points, and [[Archaeology#Ascension|Ascension]] level
* [[Fishing]] completion points, caught [[Fishing#Legendary|Legendary Fish]], their tribute level, and their card tier
* [[Arcanist]] completion points

Bottom Right
* Unlocked [[Construct#Statues|Statues]] and their tier

==Export==
Scrolling to the bottom of the listed stats reveals an "Export Stats to JSON" button. This is the UI equivalent of using the EXPORTSTATS code.
For a full breakdown of it's contents and how to use it, refer to [[Guides/Working With ExportStats|this guide]]

==General Principles and Page Format==
Stat bonuses from different menus are usually multiplicative. For example, a 50% boost to your Golden Floor Multiplier from Contracts and another 50% boost from Fishing Notice Upgrades will result in a <math>1.50 \times 1.50 = 2.25</math> times increase to your final Golden Floor Multiplier.

Stat bonuses from within one menu are usually additive. For example, a 50% Pickaxe Damage boost from the Upgrade that takes Mithril Bars and another 50% boost from the Upgrade that takes Amethyst Bars will result in a <math>1+0.5+0.5=2</math> times increase to your final Pickaxe Damage. This applies to submenus of a single menu, e.g., the Dwarf Pet Pickaxe Damage boost is additive with the Dwarf Pet Skin Pickaxe Damage boost despite them being in separate tabs of the Pets menu.

There are exceptions to these principles. For example, chances for things to happen, like the Freebie Jackpot Chance, generally add even across menus. Some things can multiply within a menu, like the Hamburger and the Primal Meat Pickaxe Damage boosts. Discrepancies are noted on this page.

'''<math>+</math> and <math>\times</math> symbols on this page specify how bonuses interact. Unless otherwise noted, different menu effects are multiplicative.'''

==Crit Damage Calculations==
Each tier of Crit requires a successful roll of the previous tier and multiplies its damage with its own and each previous tiers damage multiplier. For example, a Pickaxe Ultra Crit requires a successful Crit roll, Super Crit roll and Ultra Crit roll. The final damage will be Pickaxe Damage <math>\times</math> Pickaxe Crit Damage <math>\times</math> Pickaxe Super Crit Damage <math>\times</math> Pickaxe Ultra Crit Damage.
